title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. Bought from Amazon Warehouse in “very good condition”. Vacuum showed up filthy from previous owner and with a bag labeled with a broken part. Clearly was not inspected prior to resale. No comments on suction or value as I was unable to use item.

product_metadata.title: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster Handheld Vacuum, Cordless, Chili Red (HLVA320J26)
features: Included Components: (1) HLVA320J26 hand vacuum, (1) Jack plug charger, (1) Wall mount, (1) Extendable crevice tool, (1) Flip up brush, (1) Washable pleated filter; Power Source: Cordless
description: The BLACK+DECKER HLVA320J26 lithium hand vac 2.0 Ah in Chili Red features lithium technology for strong suction and long battery life (2.0 Ah battery). It has a clear bag less dirt bowl that makes it easy to see dirt and easy to empty, and allows you to easily empty the dustbin without touching the dirt. It also features a washable bowl and filter for thorough cleaning. This hand vac has a pull out extendable crevice tool for hard to reach areas, along with a flip-up brush for dusting and cleaning upholstery. A wall mount gives you a versatile storage solution, and the charging indicator light notifies you when vacuum is charging and/or fully charged. Backed by BLACK+DECKER 2 year limited warranty. Includes: 1) hand vac, 1) jack plug charger, 1) wall mount, 1) extendable crevice tool, 1) flip-up brush, 1) washable pleated filter.
